content.title: Authentication & Access Control
content.content:
SnapLogic provides enterprise-grade authentication and authorisation controls required for aerospace manufacturing deployments.

**Single Sign-On (SSO) Integration:**

- SAML 2.0 support for integration with {{customer_name}}'s identity provider (Active Directory, Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity)
- User provisioning via SAML assertions — no local password management required
- Session timeout and idle timeout configuration aligned with {{customer_name}} security policies

**Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA):**

- MFA enforcement at Org level for privileged accounts (Admin, DevOps roles)
- Integration with {{customer_name}}'s existing MFA solution via SAML IdP
- API token authentication supports MFA-protected token generation

**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):**

- Granular permissions at Org, Project Space, Project, and individual pipeline levels
- Pre-defined roles: Admin, Developer, Operator, Viewer
- Custom role creation with fine-grained permission assignment
- Group-based access management — users inherit permissions from Active Directory group membership

**Audit Logging:**

- Immutable audit trail of user authentication events (login, logout, failed attempts)
- User action logging: pipeline creation, modification, deletion, execution
- RBAC change logging: permission grants, role assignments, group membership changes
- Audit logs exportable for SIEM integration and compliance reporting
